purpose.en: Compare sensor-oriented RAW development with processed, compressed JPEG delivery.
purpose.zh-cn: 比较面向传感器的 RAW 显影与已处理、压缩的 JPEG 交付。

editorialNote.en: Adobe publishes imaging software; the comparison is a format overview, not a camera-independent image-quality test.
editorialNote.zh-cn: Adobe 是影像软件厂商；该对比是格式概述，不是跨相机的画质测试。

verification.evidence: The article compares RAW development flexibility with JPEG compression and delivery.
